name: 74429 · Coweta, OK
findings: ZIP 74429 (Coweta) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74429 (Coweta) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
57% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 74429 (Coweta) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).
